name: Sentinel Tysha Moonblade
summary: Along Darkshore’s road, Sentinel Tysha Moonblade watches a troubled coast. The night elf scout stands west of Ameth'Aran, guiding travelers and seeking help with the restless spirits haunting the nearby ruins.

sections.title: Watch upon the Road
sections.body: Sentinel Tysha Moonblade watches the road through Darkshore. East of her lie the ruins of Ameth'Aran, where cursed Highborne ghosts and malevolent banshees linger among ancient stone pillars. Auberdine's defenses are stretched thin by dangers along the coast, so Tysha asks capable travelers to uncover the history of Ameth'Aran's fall and put down its restless dead.

faq.answer: Sentinel Tysha Moonblade patrols the main road in central Darkshore, just west of Ameth'Aran. She guards the route against wandering beasts and restless specters.

faq.q: Where can I find Sentinel Tysha Moonblade?
faq.answer: You can find Sentinel Tysha Moonblade along Darkshore's north-south road, directly west of Ameth'Aran.

faq.q: What tasks does she give to adventurers?
faq.answer: Tysha sends travelers to Ameth'Aran to investigate the tragedy that ruined the ancient night elf settlement and quiet the tormented ghosts among its fallen columns.

faq.q: Is she related to anyone else in Darkshore?
faq.answer: No relatives of Tysha are known. She keeps watch alone on the road west of Ameth'Aran, guarding the way by the haunted ruins.

angles.text: As a night elf, you can help the Sentinels keep peace in lands scarred by the ancient Sundering by laying your cursed ancestors to rest.
As an Alliance traveler heading south from Auberdine toward Ashenvale, you can find one of the few friendly outposts along a perilous road filled with monsters.
